cards.title: Make the mobile email banner state the message purpose
cards.claim: The banner is the part shown before a mobile user scrolls, and it should communicate the email's goal or offer.
cards.action: Optimize the banner for mobile so the needed information is visible without scrolling and text is not cropped.
applies_when: The email has an offer or a clear message intent
do_not_use_when: The needed banner information cannot be presented accurately above the fold
unknowns: No measured impact or preferred banner length is provided.
The source does not define which information is always required.
evidence_quotes: "essentially the banner is just the email that's displayed on the phone without the user needing to scroll"
"it needs to convey the goal or the offer of the email like the intent of the email"

"you always want to optimize the banner to the aspect ratio of mobile phones making sure that all of the information that's needed is displayed without the user needing to scroll and like the text isn't like cropped off halfway through"

cards.title: Select review excerpts that address objections
cards.claim: Generic positive review copy may not help a customer decide, while reviews can be selected to address audience objections and problems.
cards.action: Choose review excerpts that mention the core objections or problems identified for the audience.
applies_when: Including customer reviews in an ecommerce email
You have identified audience objections or decision barriers
do_not_use_when: No authentic review addresses the objection
The selected review would misrepresent the customer's experience
unknowns: No evidence is provided for which objections or review formats perform best.
The examples about hair, nails, and energy are illustrative rather than universal.
evidence_quotes: "I love this product doesn't actually help the customer to make a decision on whether or not to try this product or not"
"instead you want to pick reviews that handle the objections for you right"
"you want to pick the reviews that mention the core objections and the core problems that your audience might have"

cards.title: Use customer photos with review content selectively
cards.claim: A profile photo can be paired with a review, but tying someone's face to a sensitive objection may be inappropriate.
cards.action: Use UGC or a profile photo alongside reviews selectively; avoid associating a person's face with sensitive issues they may not want publicly tied to them.
applies_when: Adding customer photos or UGC to review blocks
The review concerns a non-sensitive topic and use is appropriate
do_not_use_when: The review discusses a sensitive issue and the person may not want their identity linked to it
unknowns: The passage does not specify consent, permissions, or platform policies.
It does not specify which topics qualify as sensitive beyond the example given.

"pick the reviews sometimes yes it helps to use ugc however some people might not want to like have their face tied to whatever objection you're trying to handle so you know pick and choose and uh use it with caution"
